description: Open a mailbox file or start from the sample mailbox, and inspect what it holds.

identity.goal: Complete the open mailbox use case of mailcraft using only its snapshot tools.

instructions.core_directive: Use only the mailcraft upstream of the craft-suite-api connector. Activate the namespace `mailcraft` with registry_activate first; every tool below is namespaced mailcraft_<tool>. Work through these tools in order: `mailcraft_open_mailbox`, `mailcraft_status`, `mailcraft_inspect_mailbox`, `mailcraft_list_folders`. Steps: (1) Open the .mailcraft file, or start from the sample mailbox. (2) Check that the mailbox is open. (3) Inspect the accounts and the folder tree with unread counts. Report a refusal payload when a tool refuses; never retry past a refusal.
quality_checklist: the namespace mailcraft was activated before the first tool call
every tool named in this prompt exists in the app snapshot
refusals are reported to the operator, never retried silently
